name: Building AI Agents
outcome: Implement a bounded agent that uses tools to complete a task.
description: Implement a bounded AI agent that selects tools and performs a small research task. Define its execution loop, stop conditions, error handling and human oversight; assess when a simpler workflow is preferable.
external: Python, API integration, software testing and basic control-flow concepts.
learn: Implement a bounded tool-using agent loop
Enforce step limits, validation and controlled recovery
Compare the agent against a simpler workflow
moduleDescriptions: Compare a fixed workflow with dynamic tool selection.
Implement a small loop with explicit state and a finite step budget.
Validate tool arguments and results; recover from a failed call without unbounded retries.
Compare against a fixed workflow, record traces and require approval for consequential actions.
practice: Implement a small agent that selects between two supplied scientific functions.
acceptance: The agent terminates within a fixed budget, validates arguments, handles a failed call and is compared with a deterministic workflow.
prerequisiteRationale: A02 supplies bounded workflow composition and validation; A03 supplies tool dispatch. Both underpin the agent loop.
